entities.name: Gerald Edwin Hamilton Barrett-Hamilton
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Major Gerald Edwin Hamilton Barrett-Hamilton was a British and Irish natural historian, co-author with M. A. C. Hinton of A History of British Mammals, which remained "the most thorough, accurate and scientific publication" on British mammals until the 1950s.
